response: The use of chemoradiation instead of surgery to treat mid and low rectal tumors is not entirely safe. According to the available data, an exclusive chemoradiation therapy (CRT) approach is not safe for treating patients with low infiltrative rectal carcinoma. This suggests that while chemoradiation may be a viable treatment option in certain cases, it should be used with caution and under the guidance of an experienced healthcare professional, and may not be suitable for all patients with mid and low rectal tumors. Surgery may still be necessary for optimal treatment outcomes in many cases.
